scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

app.access_detail: API access included for all accounts, including free and trial; send account ID with token.
app.surface: REST; time entries, projects, clients and invoices
app.note: API v2 replaced legacy Basic auth with OAuth/PATs; include account context.
app.next_action: Use a free Harvest account and v2 OAuth/PAT with explicit account context to read a test time entry.
app.success_criterion: Return the entry and account identifier; avoid legacy Basic-auth instructions.
app.alternative_action: Use a read-only reporting workflow first, keeping invoice creation and time-entry mutation outside the initial tool.
app.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
